title: Ice Cream Float Pops
description: Frozen float lollies made from popping candy, vanilla ice cream and cola — recreating the magic of an ice cream float in a lolly.
steps: Put half a teaspoon of popping candy in each of 6 polystyrene cups. Add a tablespoon of ice cream and a glug of cola to each. Stir and freeze for 1 hour.
Leave the remaining ice cream out to go runny.

Insert sticks into the semi-frozen pops. Add another half teaspoon of popping candy to each. Fill each cup two-thirds full with the remaining ice cream. Level and clean the inside edges. Freeze for another hour.
Fill almost to the brim with the remaining cola. Freeze for 3 more hours.
Run the outside of each cup under a hot tap for 10 seconds to release.
notes: Makes 6 pops. Roll in popping candy before eating for one final kick.
